## Batch 83 complete

Added the complex Grassmann geometry needed for the finite-basis PC-VAR example, including tangent projections, the projector energy gradient, and a first-order polar retraction. The B example now uses the inspected batch-92 energy and gradient suppliers as forward references and proves the trust-region \(O(\varepsilon^{-2})\) trial bound. The complex geometry was checked against [Manton’s treatment](https://cseweb.ucsd.edu/classes/sp24/cse291-e/papers/StiefelManifold/UnitaryConstraints.pdf) and [Boumal’s book](https://www.nicolasboumal.net/book/IntroOptimManifolds_Boumal_2023.pdf).
